answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake in a cryptographic vault that burns collateral quadratically: forging N identities requires burning proportional to N^2 tokens. A solitary adversary cannot find a safe haven behind cheap clones, as each split identity turns an evasive whisper into an exponential burn penalty. When malicious attempts surge, the tide of automated slashing imposes superlinear cost scaling that bankrupts attackers.
